items.headline: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.excerpt: Give your agents access to hundreds of tools while using fewer tokens with Tool Retrieval, now in preview in the Gemini API.

items.headline: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
items.excerpt: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.

items.headline: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
items.excerpt: The Google Gemini app now supports lower-memory Android devices. Access Gemini Live and custom image creation on your phone. Download the app today.

items.headline: Put Gemini to work for you
items.excerpt: Tasks in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries, with new features starting in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration to get things done on your behalf.

items.headline: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
items.excerpt: Plan holiday road trips, get route tips, find local appointments, and search your saved lists with new Ask Maps features.
